context:
Goal: You read every box by its name, never a number.
Problem (rule): D259 (boxes show names only) says a box is shown only by its name, everywhere. Home, the capture screen, a CLI refusal and the Codes screen still draw 'Box N' or 'Slot N'. D259 lists two exceptions only, and its check does not scan screen text, so nothing catches these.
Based on (read): banchi app/src/Home.tsx:405, CaptureScreen.tsx:4555 and cli/cmd_emit.py:263-275 draw box numbers (main 0657163).
Based on (read): D259 line 60 lists only two numbered refusals as exceptions.
Departs from: D259 shows boxes only by name and four places show numbers — those four places are named as exceptions, or fixed to names.

lastAnswer.note: Your note: we dont have screen checke on banchi? Answer: banchi has two checks that read every drawn screen (app/tests/text-checks.spec.ts and copy-checks.spec.ts, one sweep in routeSweep.ts), but neither reads box numbers; the box-number check (R2-box-number in scripts/kit-adoption.mjs) reads source only. The fix lane extends the sweep. Filed in banchi D259, draft PR https://github.com/shivinate7/banchi/pull/1034; closes when it merges.

options.gain: No screen work; records match the screens.
options.how: Add these four places to D259 as named exceptions.
options.label: Name the exceptions
options.lose: The box number stays visible where you ruled it hidden.

options.how: A lane changes each place to show the name, and the check learns to scan screen text.
options.label: Fix the screens
